mapper.select: select a.ID, a.BEAD_CODE, a.MACHINE_CODE, a.LOSS_RATE, a.REMARK, a.CREATE_BY, a.CREATE_TIME, a.UPDATE_BY, a.UPDATE_TIME, b.MACHINE_NAME from T_TQ_LOSS_SETTING a left join T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO b on a.MACHINE_CODE = b.MACHINE_CODE and b.IS_DELETE = 0 where a.IS_DELETE = 0 and INSTR(a.BEAD_CODE, #{beadCode}) > 0 and a.MACHINE_CODE = #{machineCode} order by a.CREATE_TIME desc
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO T_TQ_LOSS_SETTING ( BEAD_CODE, MACHINE_CODE, LOSS_RATE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, REMARK, IS_DELETE ) VALUES
( #{item.beadCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.lossRate,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{item.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0 )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE LOSS_RATE = VALUES(LOSS_RATE), UPDATE_BY = VALUES(CREATE_BY), UPDATE_TIME = NOW(), REMARK = VALUES(REMARK)
